data.title: 久岛鸥 · 烛光木屋里的真情流露
data.description: 暴风雨夜的废弃山中小屋里，烛火在潮湿的风中摇曳。白色的长睡裙薄如蝉翼，鸥紧紧依偎在怀中，褪去了白天的古灵精怪，像一只容易受惊的小鹿般微微发抖。
data.location: rustic weathered mountain cabin with rain drumming fiercely against windowpanes
data.action: 白色的长睡裙薄如蝉翼，鸥紧紧依偎在怀中，褪去了白天的古灵精怪
data.lighting: fragile amber glow of a single tallow candle dancing across damp wooden walls
data.promptProse: Inside a storm-swept mountain cabin where a single flickering candle pushes back the dark, Kamome huddles close in her partner's embrace, trembling softly and looking up with unguarded, tearful warmth.
data.animaCaption: Clinging tightly in her partner's arms inside the candlelit mountain cabin while rain lashes the windowpane, she shivers and looks up with tearful flushed eyes in a whisper-thin white ruffled cotton nightgown slipping off one shoulder.
data.nsfwProse: Her delicate white heirloom cotton nightgown with ruffled sleeves and scalloped lace trim hangs sheer and loose off one bare shoulder in the warm candlelight.
